calls.statement:
WITH period_sales AS (
  SELECT
    f.sales_line_id,
    f.net_amount,
    s.format,
    d.fiscal_week
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 5 AND 8
    AND s.store_id < 900  -- exclude web shop and training store
    AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'  -- exclude test articles
)
SELECT
  ps.format,
  SUM(ps.net_amount) AS net_sales,
  COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) AS refund_net,
  COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) / SUM(ps.net_amount) * 100 AS return_rate_pct
FROM period_sales ps
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON ps.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
GROUP BY ps.format
ORDER BY ps.format

SELECT DISTINCT format 
FROM dim_store 
WHERE is_current = TRUE
ORDER BY format
